templates.goalText: Show how many {name} the hero has collected.
Display the hero's current {name}.
Greet the player: message first, then their name.
Store the player's starting {name} value so it can be used later.
Copy the {name2} total into {name} without changing it.
Increase the player's {name} by {num2} and store the new total back in {name}.
Add the two amounts together and store the result in {name}.
Buy {name3} items at {name2} gold each, then subtract a {num} gold discount. Store the final price in {name}.
Multiply the two amounts together and store the result in {name}.
Start with {num} {name}, then spend {num2} of it and store the remaining amount back in {name}.
Add the two amounts together and store the result in {name}, then add a {num3} bonus on top and store the final total back in {name}.
Divide the first amount by the second and store the result in {name}.
Greet the player: show the message, a space, then their name.
Show the hero's name and level on one line, name first.
Ask for the player's name and save their answer in {name}.
Ask how many {name2} the player found, convert the answer to a number, and store that number in {name2}.
If the player's {name} is at least {num3}, show {msg}.
Show {msg} when {name} reaches {num3}; otherwise show {msg2}.
Label the player {msg} at level 15 or higher, {msg2} at level 8 or higher, otherwise 'Beginner'.
Print every number from 0 up to (but not including) {num}.
Add every number from 0 up to (but not including) {num} into {name}.
Keep counting {name} up by one until it reaches {num}, then stop.
Welcome the player, then ask how many {name2} they want and save the answer in {name}.
Subtract the damage from the starting total and store what is left in {name}.
